# Volumetric hydration-heat source Q(t), specimens M1-M4, two campaigns
# Recovered by fixed-conductance PINN at each specimen's RMSE-minimum conductance beta.
# Specimen: concrete cylinder, radius 0.0375 m, height 0.15 m.
#
# UNITS:  time in hours [h];  Q in watts per cubic metre of concrete [W/m^3]
# Time zero = start of retained window (= record start + 2 h). Time step 60 s.
# SS  = campaign 13-20 April 2025;  22A = campaign 22 April 2025 (NaN after its record ends at 163.1 h)
#
# Columns:
#   1  time_h [h]
#   2  M1_SS_W_m3 [W/m^3]   beta = 9.494 W/(m^2 K)
#   3  M2_SS_W_m3 [W/m^3]   beta = 9.494 W/(m^2 K)
#   4  M3_SS_W_m3 [W/m^3]   beta = 10 W/(m^2 K)
#   5  M4_SS_W_m3 [W/m^3]   beta = 8 W/(m^2 K)
#   6  M1_22A_W_m3 [W/m^3]   beta = 15 W/(m^2 K)
#   7  M2_22A_W_m3 [W/m^3]   beta = 10 W/(m^2 K)
#   8  M3_22A_W_m3 [W/m^3]   beta = 10 W/(m^2 K)
#   9  M4_22A_W_m3 [W/m^3]   beta = 7 W/(m^2 K)
#
# time_h      M1_SS      M2_SS      M3_SS      M4_SS     M1_22A     M2_22A     M3_22A     M4_22A

# Volumetric hydration-heat source Q(t), specimens M1-M4, two campaigns
# Method: fixed-beta finite-volume / Tikhonov inversion (axisymmetric FV, cubic B-spline source,
#         16 basis functions, 2nd-difference penalty 0.05), per-sensor offset correction.
# Boundary conductance: beta = 2.5 W/(m^2 K) on all faces
#   (13-20 April late-record ambient-cycle fit: 2-3 W/(m^2 K); Arrieta cooling test: 2.1-3 W/(m^2 K)).
# Specimen: concrete cylinder, radius 0.0375 m, height 0.15 m; rho = 2476 kg/m^3, cp = 1023 J/(kg K).
# Cement content (Arrieta mix design): 350.77 kg/m^3.
#
# UNITS:  time in hours [h];  Q in watts per cubic metre of concrete [W/m^3]
# Time zero = start of retained window (= record start + 2 h). Time step 10 min.
# SS = campaign 13-20 April 2025;  22A = campaign 22 April 2025 (NaN after its record ends)
# 22A sources are LOWER CONFIDENCE: the single ambient sensor does not reproduce the
# specimens' response to daily cycles (fit RMSE ~0.4 K vs ~0.1-0.2 K for SS).
#
# Total heat over the record, Q integrated [MJ/m^3] / per gram cement [J/g] / adiabatic rise [K]
#   column        beta=2.1             beta=2.5 (this file)   beta=3.0
#   M1_SS    74.1 / 211 / 29.2     88.1 / 251 / 34.8    105.8 / 302 / 41.8  
#   M2_SS    80.4 / 229 / 31.8     95.7 / 273 / 37.8    114.7 / 327 / 45.3  
#   M3_SS    79.1 / 226 / 31.2     94.1 / 268 / 37.2    112.9 / 322 / 44.6  
#   M4_SS    84.3 / 240 / 33.3    100.2 / 286 / 39.5    120.1 / 342 / 47.4  
#   M1_22A   50.9 / 145 / 20.1     61.2 / 175 / 24.2     74.1 / 211 / 29.3  
#   M2_22A   69.1 / 197 / 27.3     82.4 / 235 / 32.5     99.0 / 282 / 39.1  
#   M3_22A   61.0 / 174 / 24.1     73.3 / 209 / 28.9     88.5 / 252 / 34.9  
#   M4_22A   61.5 / 175 / 24.3     73.6 / 210 / 29.1     88.7 / 253 / 35.0  
#
# Columns: 1 time_h [h]; 2-5 M1..M4 SS [W/m^3]; 6-9 M1..M4 22A [W/m^3]
# time_h     M1_SS     M2_SS     M3_SS     M4_SS    M1_22A    M2_22A    M3_22A    M4_22A
